title: Vector Future
body:
Embark on a unique Minecraft journey that blends technology, farming, and immersive roleplaying! This modpack brings together the powerful automation of Create, the rich social interactions of Minecraft Comes Alive, and the diverse agriculture of Croptopia.

> 🛠 Create: Build complex contraptions and beautiful mechanical systems with rotating shafts, trains, and elegant automation.

> 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Minecraft Comes Alive: Say goodbye to empty villages! Interact with villagers like never before — build relationships, start a family, and shape a living community.

> 🌾 Croptopia: Expand your farming experience with dozens of new crops, recipes, and foods from around the world.

Whether you're a builder, farmer, engineer, or storyteller, this modpack offers a perfect blend of creativity, progression, and roleplay.
